vcon.description: Syntactic version of the JSON format used in the vCon

uuid.description: Globally unique identifier for the vCon

created_at.description: Creation time of this vCon (RFC3339); MUST NOT change after creation

updated_at.description: Last modified time of this vCon (RFC3339)

subject.description: Subject or topic of the conversation

redacted.description: Reference to the unredacted or prior less-redacted vCon instance version; mutually exclusive with appended and group

appended.description: Reference to the prior vCon instance version to which data has been appended; mutually exclusive with redacted and group

group.description: Array of Group Objects aggregating multiple vCons into a single conversation; mutually exclusive with redacted and appended

parties.description: Array of Party Objects for all parties involved in the conversation

dialog.description: Array of Dialog Objects containing the captured conversation

analysis.description: Array of Analysis Objects containing analysis performed on the conversation

attachments.description: Array of Attachment Objects for ancillary documents related to the conversation

ContentHash.description: Single hash token or array of hash tokens for externally referenced content
